podcast.title: Glenn Gold's Philosophical View of Bach
podcast.body: Glenn Gold deeply revered Johann Sebastian Bach, regarding him as the embodiment of music's fundamental criteria—a perfect and harmonious balance between emotion and logic. Gold considered Bach to be the ultimate genesis point of all music, the foundational source from which musicians across subsequent generations would draw inspiration and influence. "Para Gold Bach encarnaba los criterios fundamentales de la música, el equilibrio perfecto entre emoción y lógica."

podcast.title: Post-Mortem Revival
podcast.body: Johann Sebastian Bach was one of the most important and influential composers of all time during his life, but after his death in March 1685, he was almost forgotten until a Bach revival in the 19th century made him a retro hero in classical music. "The only reason we talk about Bach today is because there was a Bach revival in the 19th century."
